title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an 8-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, verified by the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
Since 1994, there have been 126 verified Bigfoot sightings in New England, according to the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
Boston University professor Eva Garrett expressed skepticism about Bigfoot, citing lack of scientific evidence for large undiscovered primates.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, advice columnist and daughter of Ann Landers, passed away at 86 in Cambridge.
Howard, known for her practical and empathetic advice, previously wrote the Dear Prudence column for Slate.
Meredith Goldstein reflects on Howard's influence, emphasizing her advice to find happiness and not dwell on loss.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games with a 13-1 victory over the Athletics.
Payton Tolle set a career high with 14 strikeouts, allowing two hits over six innings without any walks.
The Red Sox offense collected 15 hits, including a five-run second inning led by Jarren Duran's two-run homer.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez engage in intense training camp battles to prepare for the 2026 NFL season.
Christian Gonzalez uses intentional trash talk with Brown to simulate challenges from top receivers.
Despite contract discussions, Gonzalez is actively participating in camp; Patriots may offer a lucrative new deal.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman, acquired by the Red Sox from the Orioles, will start a rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester on Saturday.
Rutschman was placed on the injured list by Baltimore on July 20 due to left wrist inflammation and last played on July 18.
Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy confirmed Rutschman will play five innings and bat two or three times in his rehab game.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' (2026) is streaming on Paramount+, featuring Aang's confrontation with an ancient warrior.
'The Ballad of Wallis Island' stars Tim Key and is streaming on Peacock as a comedy-drama about a lottery winner.
'Sterling Point' Season 1 debuts on Prime Video, following Annie (Ella Rubin) who inherits a remote Canadian island.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet may return to the Red Sox bullpen in 2026 after a prolonged injury recovery.
Interim manager Chad Tracy expressed doubts about Crochet's ability to resume starting role this season.
Crochet, recovering from lat and shoulder injuries, is open to rejoining the bullpen to help the team.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named 'Tippy' was found near Ellington Street in Dorchester on Wednesday.
Residents reported the snake after seeing it left in a cage near a community food garden.
Tippy, now at a Roslindale animal care facility, is in good condition under Boston Animal Care and Control.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Team Blue, led by Tommy DeVito, defeated Team White with a 22-15 score in Patriots' training camp scrimmage.
Wide receiver DeMario Douglas stood out with six catches and two touchdowns for Team Blue, aiding their victory.
Quarterback Drake Maye of Team White completed 10-of-19 passes and faced consistent pressure leading to hurried throws.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich voted best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers in an informal poll with over 850 participants.
Harwich features nearly 11 miles of shoreline, 20 beaches, and attractions like Cape Cod Lavender Farm.
Emily Mitchell, town clerk, highlights Harwich's cultural, historical, and recreational offerings appealing to all ages.
